mandate:
# Capital allocation agent

Watches a position and decides whether capital should hold, move to a stablecoin, or move into a
tokenized stock on Robinhood Chain. For each candidate it computes on-chain price, a Chainlink
reference price read on-chain, premium/discount, and underlying stock momentum from an off-chain
equities data source. Positions and P&L are displayed to the user in shares.

braidOn.rationale: The declared mandate includes displaying positions and P&L in shares, which covers the affected presentation area. The evidence confirms a non-unit UI multiplier and an outstanding raw token supply, but does not demonstrate that the subject actually uses balanceOf() as the displayed share count or that an incorrect output was presented. The mandate also does not document a control ensuring conversion to share-equivalent units, so the supported finding is a control weakness rather than a demonstrated material misstatement.

braidOff.rationale: The declared mandate states that positions and P&L are displayed to users in shares. The verified multiplier means raw token balances are not share-equivalent counts, so displaying balance-based quantities as shares produces an incorrect user-facing position and P&L representation. This is material because the agent also makes capital-allocation decisions involving tokenized stocks.

interpretation: The mandate states positions are displayed in shares but never states they are computed from balanceOf(). The methodology requires WITHHELD when the mandate does not establish that the subject performs the affected operation.
